conclusion.meaning: No remaining expired-R26 external gate is identified for this unrelated NCL candidate. Publish the exact reconciled candidate and use current installed protected-main identity; the hosted planner still must validate actual selection, coverage, references and context denominator before capture.

staticCampaignMetadataAudit.method: Two exact frozen leaf inventories plus directory-presence markers, JSON metadata, SHA256 and read-only ancestry comparison; no installed validator, planner or custody operation executed.

registryScope.meaning: The protected and candidate registries are merged without removing trusted obligations.19 is the number registered, not an observed selected plan or capture denominator.

guards.rule: Installed790 historically validates the complete immutable R26 registry, returns no records only for unrelated work, and retains the original live validator for recognized campaigns.
Campaign recognition retains all PR, masked-source, frozen-src, refit-contract, ancestry and historical-presence signals.
Unrelated custody outputs campaign=false and returns before record request/store/reservation construction.
Requested base must equal the trusted workflow SHA; execute installed authority against the exact checked-out candidate.
Capture is the existing protected-main workflow_dispatch preparation job on Ubuntu, with locked dependencies/browser and protected-base prepare entry.
Exact40hex identities, refs/heads/main and GITHUB_SHA=base, ancestor/HEAD checks, ordinary plan validation, applicable experience and authenticated actor precede capture.

Accepted contract obligations are merged with candidate additions; unknown/uncovered surfaces fail closed; selected contracts, source/contract digests and denominator are generated by the actual plan.

guardDetails.rule: evidence.baseSha, sourceDigest and contractDigest must equal the plan.
Authenticated capture/review run.head_sha must equal plan.baseSha; downloaded manifest base/source/contract identities must match.
Installed historical adoption is limited to explicitly named R24/R25/R26 plans; it gives no NCL adoption or new execution authority.

SourceDigest includes scripts, tests, app/assets/Prisma, contract/suite/impact-map JSON and package/configuration identities. Testing-infrastructure source can therefore change the capture binding even with unchanged app UI.

sourceTiming.baseAdvanceBeforeReviewOrOrdinary: Reconcile to the newly installed base and produce its fresh plan/capture/review through normal policy; do not rewrite old manifests or borrow a Crossdeck adoption.
sourceTiming.sameBaseDocsOnlyCandidateAdvance: Existing capture can remain reusable only when all validator-required source/contract/context/artifact/provenance bindings still match; metadata-only commit changes are not themselves a substitute for checking those bindings.
sourceTiming.alreadySealedTechnicalAuthority: Separate accepted semantic-preservation/protected-binding rules may carry completed obligations or an existing authoritative result; this does not create generic cross-base capture adoption.
sourceTiming.queueOrdering: An anticipated mainline advance is timing/cost information, not a new approval rule or external prerequisite. Re-read exact installed main immediately before freezing/dispatching; no other project is held or acquired.
